#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;

    int max_idx = 2 * n + 2;
    vector<vector<long long>> dp(max_idx, vector<long long>(max_idx, 0));
    dp[1][1] = 1;

    for (int i = 1; i < 2 * n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            long long ways = dp[i][j];
            if (ways == 0) continue;
            if (j - 1 >= 0) {
                dp[i + 1][j - 1] = (dp[i + 1][j - 1] + ways) % MOD;
            }
            if (j + 1 <= 2 * n) {
                dp[i + 1][j + 1] = (dp[i + 1][j + 1] + ways) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 2 * n - 1; i += 2) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (2 * n - i >= j) {
                ans = (ans + dp[i][j]) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
